title: Person profile
summary: Another person's profile: name, @, photo, the verified seal or the not-verified label, the company seal for a business, the public bio when published, and the actions message, block and report. Opens from a chat header, a member list, a contact match, a scanned QR code or a bipe.chat/@handle link.

kind.description: From the badge envelope verified on the device and the company seal state. Never from the profile record.

verifiedName.description: The verified legal name (person) or the legal and trade names (company).

userId.description: Matrix ID. Known from a chat; from a link it comes from GET /v1/handles/{handle}. Never shown.

displayName.description: Client.getProfile display name, else the public profile name.

avatarUrl.description: Matrix avatar or public profile photo.

isCompany.description: GET /v1/accounts/{userId}/type is company. Draws the avatar as a rounded square (ADR 0132).

bio.description: From GET /v1/profiles/{handle} when the profile is on.

isBlocked.description: The user ID is in Client.ignoredUsers.

url.description: https://bipe.chat/@handle, a QR code with that link, or a matrix.to user permalink.

openFromLink.effect: Takes the handle (or the Matrix ID from a permalink) from the URL, resolves it and loads the profile.

load.effect: Client.getProfile, GET /v1/badges/{userId} verified on the device, GET /v1/accounts/{userId}/type and, with a handle, GET /v1/profiles/{handle}.

message.effect: Opens the DM: Client.getDmRoom, else Client.createRoom for a new encrypted DM (ADR 0141). A stranger's DM arrives on the other side as a chat request.

share.effect: Shares the profile link (BipeProfileLink.url) with the system share sheet. Only with a handle.

notes: Trust UI (trust-ui.md): the seal shape and the verified-name line mean verified, never the colour alone. A person without a valid badge shows bipe_public_profile_not_verified in the neutral style.

Badges are verified on the device against registries/badge-keys.json and bound to the account's master key (security.md rule 2). Bipe logic: BadgeVerifier.verify, BipeCompanySeals.state and isCompany, BipeCNPJ.formatted (iOS); BadgeVerifier, BipeCompanySeals, BipeCompanySeal (Android).

Handle links: bipe.chat/@handle (2 to 30 characters, ADR 0065) opens this screen in the app. Bipe logic: BipeProfileLink.handle(from:) and matrixUserID(fromPermalink:) (iOS), BipeProfileLink.handle and matrixUserId (Android), BipeHandleResolver.userID(forHandle:).
The handle lookup is exact only (ADR 0013): no search. The public profile record never carries the Matrix ID; the app needs GET /v1/handles/{handle} with a token to start a chat.
No follower counts, posts or group lists (ADR 0041). Hard name mismatch and family nickname checks are chat trust cards (phase 2), not this screen.
